items.name: Drive
items.tip: Drive: how hard the selected distortion type is pushed. Higher = more saturation and harmonics.

items.name: Mech
items.tip: Mech: harder, more aggressive digital-style crunch (folds and clips the wave). 0 = off.

items.name: Type
items.tip: Distortion type. Tube: warm even harmonics. Soft Sat: smooth and symmetric, great on buses. Transistor: console-style, punchy and forward. Tape: gentle and rounded. Diode: edgy and asymmetric. Hard Clip: tight, loud and aggressive. Fuzz: thick, gated and woolly. RAT: hard-clipped, gritty distortion pedal style. Overdrive: smooth, mid-forward tube-pedal style. Rectifier: adds a bright octave-ish edge.

items.name: Cutoff
items.tip: Cutoff: frequency of the 24 dB filter (low-pass, high-pass or band-pass). As a low-pass it rolls off the harsh highs that distortion creates.

items.name: Res
items.tip: Resonance: boosts the frequencies right at the cutoff for a vocal or squelchy edge.

items.name: Filter type
items.tip: Filter type: Low-pass keeps the lows and cuts the highs, High-pass keeps the highs and cuts the lows, Band-pass keeps only a band around the cutoff.

items.name: Amount
items.tip: Compressor amount: lowers the threshold and raises the ratio together. Make-up gain is automatic, so the level stays the same at any amount and only the density changes.

items.name: Phat mode
items.tip: Phat mode: adds low-end weight before the compressor, a slower release and a soft ceiling. Great on kicks and bass.

items.name: Volume
items.tip: Volume: final output level. Match it to the bypassed level when comparing.

items.name: Mix
items.tip: Mix: dry/wet blend. Lower values keep the original punch (parallel crush).

top.name: Preset menu
top.tip: Factory presets (our own). Use the arrows to step through them.

top.name: Randomize
top.tip: Set the controls to random values (output level and on/off switches are kept).

top.name: Nasty range
top.tip: Nasty range: lets Drive, Fuzz, Squeeze, Warm and the other heavy knobs go far past 100 % for really nasty, OTT and Vengeance style sounds. Off keeps every knob at its normal top.

top.name: Limiter
top.tip: Safety limiter on the output: keeps the level from ever passing 0 dBFS, smooth and transparent. Turn it off if you want the raw output (for example to let your own limiter do the work).

top.name: Settings
top.tip: Settings: version, link to the GitHub page for new versions

top.name: Info bubbles (i)
top.tip: Info bubbles: hover a control for one second to see what it does. Click to turn them off or on.
